title: How often should I service my AC in Al Barsha South?
desc: You need to schedule maintenance service every 6 months for better performance.

title: Why is my AC cooling slowly?
desc: Dirty filters, low refrigerant levels and airflow restrictions are common reasons for slow cooling.

title: Is same-day AC repair available in Al Barsha South?
desc: Yes, FAJ Technical Services L.L.C provides emergency and same-day AC repair services but it depends on the technician's schedule and workload. Same-day support may be available.

title: What causes water leakage from an AC?
desc:
Common causes include:
  • Blocked drainage lines
  • Frozen evaporator coils
  • Dirty filters

title: What is included in the AC maintenance service?
desc:
Maintenance normally includes:
  • Filter cleaning
  • Coil inspection
  • Drainage cleaning
  • Thermostat testing
  • Performance checks

title: Is an AMC worth having?
desc: Yes, Regular servicing helps reduce breakdowns and improve long-term performance.

title: Why is my AC making noise?
desc:
Some common reasons include:
  • Loose internal parts
  • Fan motor problems
  • Dirt buildup inside the unit

title: Do you provide AC services for offices and businesses?
desc: Yes, services are available for offices, retail stores, schools, clinics, and commercial properties.

title: Can AC cleaning improve indoor air quality?
desc: Yes, removing dust and contaminants helps create cleaner and healthier indoor air.

title: How long does AC maintenance take?
desc: Most maintenance visits take around one hour, depending on system size and condition.

title: Do you provide warranty on services?
desc: Yes, AC cleaning and maintenance services include a 60-day service warranty.

title: Can regular servicing lower electricity bills?
desc: Yes, efficient systems consume less energy and often reduce monthly electricity costs.

title: Why does my air conditioner take so long to cool the room?
desc: The filters might be dirty, and the gas might be low. The unit might be too small for the room. A technician can check the AC system. Suggest the right solution.

title: Do I need to service my air conditioner before summer starts?
desc: Yes. You should service your AC before summer. Servicing your AC before summer prepares your air conditioner for the load ahead. It helps avoid breakdowns when the weather gets hot outside.
